# TeX Live 2026 CJK runtime subset

This directory contains 20 unmodified runtime files selected from the fixed
`TeXlyre/texlyre-busytex-build` `texlive-full-2026` archive. The exact source
archive, package revisions, paths, byte sizes and SHA-256 values are recorded in
`config/rinspace/texlive-cjk.review.json`. The files are data loaded by BusyTeX;
they are not relicensed as part of TeXlyre.

- `CJKfntef.sty` is from CJK 4.8.5, copyright 1994–2021 Werner
  Lemberg and contributors, under GPL version 2 or later. Its file header
  contains the license notice. Upstream: <https://ctan.org/pkg/cjk>.
- The `ctex` files are from TeX Live revision 77682 and are under LPPL 1.3c
  or later. Their generated-file headers carry the copyright and LPPL notice.
  Upstream: <https://ctan.org/pkg/ctex>.
- The `xeCJK` files are from TeX Live revision 77682 and are under LPPL 1.3c
  or later. Their generated-file headers carry the copyright and LPPL notice.
  Upstream: <https://ctan.org/pkg/xecjk>.
- The `zhnumber` files are from TeX Live revision 77682 and are under LPPL
  1.3c or later. Their generated-file headers carry the copyright and LPPL
  notice. Upstream: <https://ctan.org/pkg/zhnumber>.
- The three Fandol OpenType fonts are from TeX Live revision 37889. The Fandol
  authors describe their license as “GPL + GPL font exception”. The runtime
  bytes are unmodified. Upstream notice: <https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/fandol/README>.

The GPL version 2 text is available at <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html>.
The LPPL 1.3c text is available at <https://www.latex-project.org/lppl/lppl-1-3c/>.
